format: pdf

##Housekeeping Code
```{r}
#| label: Package Loading Bay

library(brms)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(bayesplot)
library(ggdist)
library(posterior)
library(scales)
```

```{r}
#| label: Data Pull

Exp1 <- read.table("../QML-2026/data/Form-Based_FinalProj/Exp1.txt", header = TRUE)
Exp2 <- read.table("../QML-2026/data/Form-Based_FinalProj/Exp2.txt", header = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: Factor for Exp1

Exp1_Factor <- Exp1 |>
  mutate(WordType = factor(WordType, levels = c("attractor", "target", "control", "implied")))
```

```{r}
#| label: Factor and Filter for Exp2

Exp2_Filt <- Exp2 |>
  filter(Accuracy == 1, Confusion == 0) |>
  mutate(WordType = factor(WordType, levels = c("attractor", "target", "control")))
```

##Preliminary Plotting
```{r}
#| label: Experiment 1.1 Plotting Code

#Scatter and Violin plot
Exp1_Factor |>
  ggplot(aes(WordType, as.numeric(Response))) +
  
  geom_jitter(width = 0.3, height = 0.25, size = 0.75, alpha = 0.5) +
  
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.4, color = "black", fill = "red") +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1:7
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Word Type",
    y = "Response (1-7)"
  ) +
  
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
  )

#Bar chart
Exp1_Factor |>
  ggplot(aes(WordType, fill = factor(Response))) +
  
  geom_bar(position = "fill") + 
  
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues") +
  
   scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1:7
  ) +
  
  scale_y_reverse() +
  
  labs(
    x = "Word Type",
    y = "Response (1-7)",
    fill = "Reponse"
  ) +
  
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = T)) +
  
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )
```
